responsibility: Defines regression and conformance tests for `SipHasher128`, checking that the 128-bit hasher matches known test vectors, preserves architecture-dependent `usize`/`isize` hashing behavior, includes all input bytes and length boundaries in the hash stream, and keeps the specialized integer write methods equivalent to hashing their native-endian byte representations across buffer boundary cases.
same_name_distinction: Among the hashing `tests.rs` files, this one is the low-level `SipHasher128` conformance suite: it checks known vectors, architecture-dependent `usize` behavior, dropped-byte and concat-alias regressions, and equivalence between typed writes and raw native-endian bytes.
